name: Peasants
_comment: Occupations. nomadic: roams with the herds. taxed (default: not nomadic): pays tax. levied (default true): answers the levy. research: research points a month per unit (1000 people); all technologies draw on the same points. The educated class carries research, artisans and peasants add a little. start_share: share of the settled people of settled countries' core provinces who have this occupation at the start (taken from the peasants, the largest provinces first).

name: Artisans
description: Smiths, potters, carpenters and weavers of the towns. Their workshops now and then turn up a better way of doing things.

name: Scribes
description: The educated class of the state: scribes, scholars and officials who keep the records, the law and the accounts.

name: Priests
description: Servants of the gods and keepers of learning: they watch the stars, heal the sick and teach. Temples pay no tax.
